graph_diagnosis.summary: Inventory changes, demand concerns, and oil-market sentiment provide a reusable WTI framework.
weaknesses: The graph contains no supported OPEC, geopolitical, or dollar transmission path.
All links to option outcomes are excluded; direct price observations provide only limited mechanism support.

search_factors.why_search: Inventory draws or builds signal changes in physical balance.
Major-consumer demand concerns can weaken oil pricing.
Technical and market sentiment can amplify direction when balances are uncertain.
Fuel-stock changes can qualify a crude-inventory signal.

checkpoints.mechanism: Crude inventory draws can tighten the physical balance.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Crude and product inventory changes are confirmed across releases.

checkpoints.mechanism: A tighter balance can support oil-price pressure.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Inventory draw and market pricing move together.

checkpoints.mechanism: Lingering demand concerns can offset inventory-driven support.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Demand indicators weaken across major consuming regions.

checkpoints.mechanism: Market uncertainty can amplify or delay the balance signal.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Technical conditions agree with physical-balance evidence.

checkpoints.factor: Physical balance and demand into WTI
checkpoints.mechanism: Inventory signals, demand conditions, and market sentiment combine to determine WTI direction.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Reconcile inventories, demand data, and futures pricing.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: WTI persistently diverges from physical-balance evidence.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: Inventory draws can tighten balances and support WTI.
applicability_conditions: Product balances do not offset crude draws.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: Demand concerns and uncertainty can offset a tight-balance signal.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: Fuel-stock builds and weak demand neutralize crude draws.
alternative_hypotheses.discriminating_evidence: Compare crude and product inventories with demand indicators.

forecast_audit_questions: Do crude and product inventories point to the same balance?
Do demand indicators offset inventory support?
Does futures pricing confirm the physical signal?
